🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 In Keralam, the children beyond healthcare

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:36:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Attappady’s recurring infant deaths this year point to a crisis that goes beyond malnutrition and access to timely healthcare. Poverty, land alienation, and the erosion of traditional food systems, are taking a toll on maternal and child health in this predominantly tribal region of Keralam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Between the pages of a logbook recording Dakshina’s treatment are ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, and ₹10 notes. Dakshina’s mother, Minnal Rani, had filed them away for her daughter’s medical expenses. The child is gone, but the money remains untouched. “We will never spend it,” she says, fighting back tears. Dakshina was five months old when doctors detected a hole in her heart. Born on June 13, 2025, she was taken to many hospitals, including one in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam’s capital. With surgery ruled out, she was eventually referred to a cooperative hospital at Perinthalmanna, in Malappuram district, a two-and-a-half-hour drive away from home. She died here, on April 13, 2026. Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000. They managed to raise the money with the help of a ward councillor. “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. Of the 10 infant deaths, six involved congenital anomalies, with heart defects among the commonly reported conditions. An expert committee of doctors and researchers is examining the deaths.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ground Zero / Keralam / infants / health / government health care

articles.title: This 2D rhythm platformer video game is an ode to India’s multiplicities
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A still from Suri: The Seventh Note | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 This 2D rhythm platformer video game is an ode to India’s multiplicities

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:36:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A still from Suri: The Seventh Note | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Entertainment (Adjective)
मनोरंजन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Entertainment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

प्ले स्टेशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Playstation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Arrangement (Adjective)
व्यवस्था — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Arrangement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Interactive (Adjective)
इंटरएक्टिव — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Interactive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "This 2D rhythm platformer video game is an ode to India’s multiplicities", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music." But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.

articles.title: CCMB team identifies genes that spur nerve repair, raise possibility of paralysis treatment
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Scientists at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) , Hyderabad, have identified two genes that can restore damaged nerve cells’ ability to regenerate, raising the possibility of new gene-based treatments for paralysis caused by spinal cord injuries.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The study, led by Ishwariya Venkatesh, found that activating two developmental genes, NR2F1 and NR2F6, enabled severed nerve fibres to regrow across completely injured spinal cords in mice, leading to measurable improvements in movement. The spinal cord transmits signals from the brain to the rest of the body, enabling movement and sensation. Damage to it can cause paralysis because nerve cells in adult mammals generally lose their ability to regenerate. Despite decades of research, there is no treatment that can restore the lost neural connections. The researchers sought to understand why young neurons can grow and regenerate while adult neurons cannot. Their investigation focused on proteins that activate growth-related genes during development but become less active as the brain matures. The team discovered that the genes NR2F1 and NR2F6, which had not previously been linked to nerve regeneration, decline by 70-80% in adult brains. Restoring either gene in adult mice prompted damaged nerve fibres to regenerate across the injury site and extend beyond it. Untreated animals, by contrast, showed little or no regrowth. The treated mice also showed improved mobility, including better hind-limb movement and grip strength. Recovery became evident about five weeks after the injury and continued thereafter. The two genes, however, triggered regeneration through different mechanisms. NR2F1 activated genes involved in remodelling DNA and rebuilding cellular structures needed for growth. NR2F6, meanwhile, suppressed several routine cellular activities, allowing neurons to redirect resources towards repairing damaged nerve fibres. The team also found that NR2F6 reorganises the three-dimensional structure of DNA in injured neurons, bringing growth-related genes closer to the regulatory elements that control their activity. Researchers said this was the first evidence linking large-scale genome reorganisation to nerve regeneration in the brain or spinal cord.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Published in The EMBO Journal , the study is still at the preclinical stage. The genes were delivered before the injury in mice, and the recovery was partial. The findings, however, offer a potential framework for developing gene-based therapies to repair spinal cord damage, said a press release.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 CCMB team identifies genes that spur nerve repair, raise possibility of paralysis treatment

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:34:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Scientists at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) , Hyderabad, have identified two genes that can restore damaged nerve cells’ ability to regenerate, raising the possibility of new gene-based treatments for paralysis caused by spinal cord injuries.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The study, led by Ishwariya Venkatesh, found that activating two developmental genes, NR2F1 and NR2F6, enabled severed nerve fibres to regrow across completely injured spinal cords in mice, leading to measurable improvements in movement. The spinal cord transmits signals from the brain to the rest of the body, enabling movement and sensation. Damage to it can cause paralysis because nerve cells in adult mammals generally lose their ability to regenerate. Despite decades of research, there is no treatment that can restore the lost neural connections. The researchers sought to understand why young neurons can grow and regenerate while adult neurons cannot. Their investigation focused on proteins that activate growth-related genes during development but become less active as the brain matures. The team discovered that the genes NR2F1 and NR2F6, which had not previously been linked to nerve regeneration, decline by 70-80% in adult brains. Restoring either gene in adult mice prompted damaged nerve fibres to regenerate across the injury site and extend beyond it. Untreated animals, by contrast, showed little or no regrowth. The treated mice also showed improved mobility, including better hind-limb movement and grip strength. Recovery became evident about five weeks after the injury and continued thereafter. The two genes, however, triggered regeneration through different mechanisms. NR2F1 activated genes involved in remodelling DNA and rebuilding cellular structures needed for growth. NR2F6, meanwhile, suppressed several routine cellular activities, allowing neurons to redirect resources towards repairing damaged nerve fibres. The team also found that NR2F6 reorganises the three-dimensional structure of DNA in injured neurons, bringing growth-related genes closer to the regulatory elements that control their activity. Researchers said this was the first evidence linking large-scale genome reorganisation to nerve regeneration in the brain or spinal cord.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Published in The EMBO Journal , the study is still at the preclinical stage. The genes were delivered before the injury in mice, and the recovery was partial. The findings, however, offer a potential framework for developing gene-based therapies to repair spinal cord damage, said a press release.

जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Regeneration (Noun)
उत्थान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Regeneration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Over 1 crore HPV vaccines given to 14-year-old girls in nine months: Health Ministry
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations, the Ministry said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has administered more than one crore doses of the HPV vaccine to 14-year-old girls under its national vaccination campaign in less than nine months, covering nearly 87% of the identified annual target, the Health Ministry said on Saturday (November 21, 2026). The nationwide HPV vaccination campaign, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in February this year, provides free, voluntary and single-dose vaccination to 14-year-old girls at designated government health facilities with parental consent. The annual target cohort comprises around 1.2 crore girls, based on Registrar General of India (RGI) 2021 population estimates. Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations, the Ministry said. Among other States, Assam has recorded 95.63% coverage, followed by Telangana (95.28%), Karnataka (93.16%) and Uttarakhand (90.17%). Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan have crossed the 80% mark with 86.21% and 85.23% coverage, respectively. Kerala has recorded 77.02% coverage, Tamil Nadu 76.12%, Odisha 74.90% and the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu 72.99%. In absolute numbers, Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar with over 13.70 lakh and Gujarat with more than 7.75 lakh, according to the Ministry. The milestone reflects coordinated efforts by the Centre, States and Union Territories, district administrations, healthcare workers, teachers, parents and local communities, it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The campaign has also focused on community engagement and dissemination of science-based information on HPV vaccination, with healthcare professionals, including paediatricians, gynaecologists, and specialists from institutions such as AIIMS, helping address concerns about vaccine safety and effectiveness.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Over 1 crore HPV vaccines given to 14-year-old girls in nine months: Health Ministry

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:21:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations, the Ministry said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has administered more than one crore doses of the HPV vaccine to 14-year-old girls under its national vaccination campaign in less than nine months, covering nearly 87% of the identified annual target, the Health Ministry said on Saturday (November 21, 2026). The nationwide HPV vaccination campaign, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in February this year, provides free, voluntary and single-dose vaccination to 14-year-old girls at designated government health facilities with parental consent. The annual target cohort comprises around 1.2 crore girls, based on Registrar General of India (RGI) 2021 population estimates. Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations, the Ministry said. Among other States, Assam has recorded 95.63% coverage, followed by Telangana (95.28%), Karnataka (93.16%) and Uttarakhand (90.17%). Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan have crossed the 80% mark with 86.21% and 85.23% coverage, respectively. Kerala has recorded 77.02% coverage, Tamil Nadu 76.12%, Odisha 74.90% and the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu 72.99%. In absolute numbers, Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar with over 13.70 lakh and Gujarat with more than 7.75 lakh, according to the Ministry. The milestone reflects coordinated efforts by the Centre, States and Union Territories, district administrations, healthcare workers, teachers, parents and local communities, it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The campaign has also focused on community engagement and dissemination of science-based information on HPV vaccination, with healthcare professionals, including paediatricians, gynaecologists, and specialists from institutions such as AIIMS, helping address concerns about vaccine safety and effectiveness.

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Dissemination (Adjective / Verb)
प्रसार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Dissemination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Vaccination (Noun)
टीकाकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Vaccination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Information (Adjective / Verb)
जानकारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Information' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Attappady’s recurring infant deaths this year point to a crisis that goes beyond malnutrition and access to timely healthcare. Poverty, land alienation, and the erosion of traditional food systems, are taking a toll on maternal and child health in this predominantly tribal region of Keralam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Between the pages of a logbook recording Dakshina’s treatment are ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, and ₹10 notes. Dakshina’s mother, Minnal Rani, had filed them away for her daughter’s medical expenses. The child is gone, but the money remains untouched. “We will never spend it,” she says, fighting back tears. Dakshina was five months old when doctors detected a hole in her heart. Born on June 13, 2025, she was taken to many hospitals, including one in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam’s capital. With surgery ruled out, she was eventually referred to a cooperative hospital at Perinthalmanna, in Malappuram district, a two-and-a-half-hour drive away from home. She died here, on April 13, 2026. Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000. They managed to raise the money with the help of a ward councillor. “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. Of the 10 infant deaths, six involved congenital anomalies, with heart defects among the commonly reported conditions. An expert committee of doctors and researchers is examining the deaths.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ground Zero / Keralam / infants / health / government health care

Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000. They managed to raise the money with the help of a ward councillor. “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. Of the 10 infant deaths, six involved congenital anomalies, with heart defects among the commonly reported conditions. An expert committee of doctors and researchers is examining the deaths.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ground Zero / Keralam / infants / health / government health care

hinglishTracks.en: Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000.

hinglishTracks.en: “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district.

With surgery ruled out, she was eventually referred to a cooperative hospital at Perinthalmanna, in Malappuram district, a two-and-a-half-hour drive away from home. She died here, on April 13, 2026. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. articles.title: Digital planetariums, education centres will be established in all divisions: Bihar Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Requisition for appointment of 1,061 faculty posts for Engineering Colleges and 354 faculty posts for polytechnic colleges sent to BPSC

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With a view to developing a scientific temperament among students and the general public, state-of-the-art “digital planetariums and education centres” will be established in all the divisions of the state, Bihar Science and Technology Minister Sheela Kumari said on Friday (November 20, 2026). “The district magistrates of the districts concerned have been requested to provide a minimum of two acres of land for the purpose,” Ms. Kumari said while addressing a press conference in Patna. These centres will provide children and young people with practical knowledge of astronomy and space research, she said, while praising Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary’s leadership for the initiative. In reply to a query, she said that these planetariums will be ready in a year. The Minister further stated that digital planetariums/space and astronomy education centres will also be established in three districts—East Champaran, Jamui, and Purnea—as part of the Union Ministry of Culture’s Scheme for Promotion of Culture and Science (SPOCS). “The total estimated project cost is ₹39.00 crore, which will be funded with central assistance,” she said, adding that the target is to commence construction work during the current financial year, 2026-27. A digital planetarium uses computer software and high-resolution digital projectors (or LED panels) to display 3D simulations of the night sky, space travel, and science visuals inside a dome theatre. Unlike traditional optical-mechanical projectors that only show fixed star positions, digital systems can fly viewers through galaxies, simulate different time periods, and play full-dome films. Ms. Kumari was accompanied by Department Secretary Himanshu Sharma and a host of other senior officials during the press conference. In order to generate public interest in science and technology, efforts are also being made to operate mobile science exhibition buses, observatory domes, and astro parks through the National Council of Science Museums.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Notably, the state currently has two functional planetariums—one each in Patna and Darbhanga. The planetarium in Darbhanga was established in 2023, while the renovation of the Patna planetarium has already been completed.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Requisition for appointment of 1,061 faculty posts for Engineering Colleges and 354 faculty posts for polytechnic colleges sent to BPSC
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With a view to developing a scientific temperament among students and the general public, state-of-the-art “digital planetariums and education centres” will be established in all the divisions of the state, Bihar Science and Technology Minister Sheela Kumari said on Friday (November 20, 2026). “The district magistrates of the districts concerned have been requested to provide a minimum of two acres of land for the purpose,” Ms. Kumari said while addressing a press conference in Patna. These centres will provide children and young people with practical knowledge of astronomy and space research, she said, while praising Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary’s leadership for the initiative. In reply to a query, she said that these planetariums will be ready in a year. The Minister further stated that digital planetariums/space and astronomy education centres will also be established in three districts—East Champaran, Jamui, and Purnea—as part of the Union Ministry of Culture’s Scheme for Promotion of Culture and Science (SPOCS). “The total estimated project cost is ₹39.00 crore, which will be funded with central assistance,” she said, adding that the target is to commence construction work during the current financial year, 2026-27. A digital planetarium uses computer software and high-resolution digital projectors (or LED panels) to display 3D simulations of the night sky, space travel, and science visuals inside a dome theatre. Unlike traditional optical-mechanical projectors that only show fixed star positions, digital systems can fly viewers through galaxies, simulate different time periods, and play full-dome films. Ms. Kumari was accompanied by Department Secretary Himanshu Sharma and a host of other senior officials during the press conference. In order to generate public interest in science and technology, efforts are also being made to operate mobile science exhibition buses, observatory domes, and astro parks through the National Council of Science Museums.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Notably, the state currently has two functional planetariums—one each in Patna and Darbhanga. The planetarium in Darbhanga was established in 2023, while the renovation of the Patna planetarium has already been completed.

articles.title: BJP’s invitation to Pakistan’s Minister vindicates Abdullah’s stance: J&K Deputy Chief Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday (November 20, 2026) said that the BJP-led government’s move to invite Pakistan’s Minister Musadik Masood Malik to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisation Dialogue Forum “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC) president Dr. Farooq Abdullah and vice president Omar Abdullah.” Referring to the BJP’s stance after the 2025 Pahalgam attack, Mr. Choudhary said, “The BJP will say it will not talk to Pakistan. And when Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah advocate dialogue, the BJP will call them Pakistani. I want to ask the BJP: hasn’t a Pakistani Minister been invited to India on their invitation?” He said the invitation to the Pakistani Minister proved that “the stance of my leaders was right then and is right now.” “The NC’s stance is the same as the one articulated by former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, who would say, ‘You can choose your friends, but you cannot choose your neighbours.’ One must always maintain good relations with one’s neighbours,” said Mr. Choudhary. Asking Pakistan to end terrorism, Mr. Choudhary said, “Both Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah have been asking Pakistan to end terrorism and close terror camps if Pakistan wants better relations. We stand behind our leaders.” People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change, and water-related matters, which can only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

📰 BJP’s invitation to Pakistan’s Minister vindicates Abdullah’s stance: J&K Deputy Chief Minister

1. Core Context & Background: People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday (November 20, 2026) said that the BJP-led government’s move to invite Pakistan’s Minister Musadik Masood Malik to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisation Dialogue Forum “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC) president Dr. Farooq Abdullah and vice president Omar Abdullah.” Referring to the BJP’s stance after the 2025 Pahalgam attack, Mr. Choudhary said, “The BJP will say it will not talk to Pakistan. And when Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah advocate dialogue, the BJP will call them Pakistani. I want to ask the BJP: hasn’t a Pakistani Minister been invited to India on their invitation?” He said the invitation to the Pakistani Minister proved that “the stance of my leaders was right then and is right now.” “The NC’s stance is the same as the one articulated by former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, who would say, ‘You can choose your friends, but you cannot choose your neighbours.’ One must always maintain good relations with one’s neighbours,” said Mr. Choudhary. Asking Pakistan to end terrorism, Mr. Choudhary said, “Both Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah have been asking Pakistan to end terrorism and close terror camps if Pakistan wants better relations. We stand behind our leaders.” People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change, and water-related matters, which can only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

articles.title: Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:12:49 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

Alternative (Adjective)
विकल्प — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Alternative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Opportunity (Noun)
अवसर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opportunity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Interaction (Adjective / Verb)
इंटरैक्शन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Interaction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Transgender persons to be roped in for tax colle' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Transgender persons to be roped in for tax co' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Transgender persons to be roped in for tax co' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons." (Hinglish Arth: पश्चिम बंगाल की मंत्री अग्निमित्रा पॉल ने ट्रांस व्यक्तियों को सम्मानजनक, वैकल्पिक आजीविका प्रदान करने के लिए एक कार्यक्रम शुरू किया)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say." (Hinglish Arth: समुदाय के लिए काम करने वाले कई समूहों का कहना है कि तीसरे लिंग के लोगों की वास्तविक संख्या अधिक हो सकती है।)

articles.title: Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शुक्रवार (नवंबर 20, 2026) को एक पुलिस स्टेशन के बाहर भारतीय जनता पार्टी (बीजेपी) के समर्थकों द्वारा ममता ऑल इंडिया तृणमूल कांग्रेस (एआईटीसी) के समर्थकों पर कथित तौर पर हमला किया गया, जबकि पार्टी नेता अभिषेक बनर्जी से कोलकाता पुलिस गिरीश पार्क पुलिस स्टेशन में पूछताछ कर रही थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — बीजेपी के सत्ता में आने के बाद अभिषेक बनर्जी के खिलाफ कई एफआईआर दर्ज की गईं.।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:00:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

• 1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

articles.title: Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:16:29 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
वितरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Distribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Consumption (Noun)
उपभोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consumption' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: Anthropic researcher says Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Under the institute’s rules, a solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand two years of scrutiny. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. He said he and Claude had produced a version of the proof in Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical arguments to be checked by a computer, and that he was releasing only that version for now. A full written argument would be extremely long, he said, adding that he had not yet mastered all of the mathematics involved and planned to write it up properly.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Alpoge said he had consulted Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei before announcing the result and acknowledged that its timing could be viewed cynically, without elaborating, though he was probably referring to this week’s record IPO.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Anthropic researcher says Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:05:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Under the institute’s rules, a solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand two years of scrutiny. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. He said he and Claude had produced a version of the proof in Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical arguments to be checked by a computer, and that he was releasing only that version for now. A full written argument would be extremely long, he said, adding that he had not yet mastered all of the mathematics involved and planned to write it up properly.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Alpoge said he had consulted Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei before announcing the result and acknowledged that its timing could be viewed cynically, without elaborating, though he was probably referring to this week’s record IPO.

संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Mathematical (Adjective)
गणितीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Mathematical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Anthropic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Anthropic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

A. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as...

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #1 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 08:17:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Proliferation (Noun)
प्रसार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Proliferation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons." (Hinglish Arth: अमेरिका, चीन, रूस को परमाणु हथियारों पर बातचीत के लिए एक रोडमैप तैयार करना चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op." (Hinglish Arth: अन्यथा, शिखर सम्मेलन एक और राजनयिक फोटो-ऑप से थोड़ा अधिक होगा।)

articles.title: 14 flights cancelled at Ranchi airport amid Cyclone 'Akvan' | LIVE
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As many as 14 flights were cancelled at the Birsa Munda Airport in Ranchi on Saturday (November 21) due to inclement weather triggered by cyclone ‘Akvan’, an official said. Cyclone Akvan causes 14 Ranchi airport flight cancellations due to poor visibility and bad weather. Relief operations are underway on a war footing in Odisha’s Ganjam district after Cyclone Akvan. An ODRAF team carried out a tree-cutting operation under the Jarau Nal bridge in Chhandikendu village to clear the affected area. Normalcy has been restored at Puri beach after Cyclone Akvan. Beach activities have resumed, bringing the shoreline back to life after the disruption caused by the cyclone. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD
